traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 207 Sapotaceae: trees or shrubs with milky sap, often flowering on the old wood; leaves simple, alternate, entire, leathery; stipules usually absent; flowers bisexual, regular, rather small; calyx and corolla 4- to 8-lobed; stamens on the corolla, opposite its lobes; ovary superior, of several cells; fruit often a rather hard berry (sapodilla, star apple), rarely a capsule.

traits.inflorescence.note: DELTA Sapotaceae (read 2026-10-16): flowers solitary or in cymose bunches, terminal unit cymose.

traits.flowering_position.note: DELTA Sapotaceae (read 2026-10-16): inflorescences axillary, sometimes on old wood.

traits.corolla_shape.note: DELTA Sapotaceae (read 2026-10-16): corolla gamopetalous with short tube; 'campanulate' is our reading. Low-medium confidence.

traits.leaf_incision.note: DELTA, Sapotaceae (read 2026-10-17): lamina undivided, margins entire.
